entry.title: fix: persist dashboard stats and vocabulary in localStorage (#32)
entry.content:
fix: persist dashboard stats and vocabulary in localStorage (#32)

Dashboard stats (conversations, review accuracy, streak) and vocabulary
words now persist to localStorage, so they survive page reloads instead
of resetting to zero.

- Vocabulary store reads/writes localStorage (key: koe-vocabulary)
- Dashboard stats persist conversations (koe-conversations), review
  stats (koe-review-stats), and streak (koe-streak) to localStorage
- Chat page increments conversation counter on first message sent
- Added TDD persistence tests for both stores
